THE GAME PLAN
01 / Connect

Tap between two dots to draw a line. The outer border is already yours to work with.

02 / Capture

Close the fourth side of a box to claim it. Score a point, then your opponent plays.

03 / Conquer

When every box is filled, the player with the most boxes wins. Simple rules. Clever moves.

GridClash / A little strategy goes a long way.Based on Walter Tanui’s Dots & Boxes ↗Anonymous play statistics · Privacy

One more box.

Take turns selecting an interior line between two dots. Complete a box to earn a point, then pass the turn to your opponent. A single line can capture two boxes!

The outer border is pre-drawn, just like the original game. Green is player one; peach is player two. You can also use Tab and Enter to select a line.

Play against three computer difficulties or pass the device to a friend. Online multiplayer is not connected in this web edition.
